title: The app has real URLs: a refresh returns to the same screen, and sign-in and sign-up have their own paths
acceptance: Refreshing Safari on a class's detail screen or in Live returns to that class (and, in Live, to the class with the held position or a clear resume prompt), not the Classes home.
Sign-in and sign-up open at their own paths, so an invite email can link straight to sign-up.
Browser Back from sign-in returns to the landing page.
The service-worker navigation fallback still denies /api/ routes, and OAuth and reset-password callbacks still reach the Worker.
One routing approach covers both refresh-restore and the sign-in/sign-up paths, so the app does not get two routing mechanisms.
nextAction: Restart on branch feat/rf-129-real-urls (Neo). Approach is the owner's choice of 2026-11-04: real paths with no router library (/sign-in, /sign-up, /classes/<id>, /classes/<id>/live, /music, /account; old /?auth= links redirect) plus 5 fixes: Back while Live is playing stays in Live; sign-in returns to the deep link; a Class not found state; the URL is written from Dashboard state in one place and Back/Forward call the existing open/close functions; /music and /account move to a follow-up if time runs short. Service-worker config is expected to stay unchanged (fallback already denies /api/).
